categories.environments_and_caches: .venv*, .cache, .tmp, tmp remain local and are re-created from cloud profiles
categories.native_runtime: VM disks, APK/libg/resources, compiled probes/native extensions remain local; missing asset identities are retained in version manifest/EXTERNAL_ASSETS
categories.raw_data_and_media: Large original replays, source Parquet, screenshots/videos, full raw traces and downloaded papers remain local; reviewed pilot/indices/summaries included
categories.credentials: No private keys, tokens, account files, keystores or Git metadata are copied

transformations.transformation: Replace local debug signing password with environment variable; original local script retained

model_scope: Historical NumPy models from reviewed release, plus one runnable phase3 GRU; other local experiments stay in original project
